The new log.info call logs only caseId and actor.userId(), so on inspection it carries no NPI. However, the registered control test is sample-only and there is no valid CI run on the head commit to back it.
Ticket CHG-24001 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim at 2026-10-26T08:16Z, before review. Its component mortgage.cases covers the only changed file, CaseService.java.
Declan Farrell approved the code review. He holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is a different person from the author, Priya Raman.
The code_review approval names head commit ecde0640, and there are no later commits.

run.json claims commit ecde0640 started 2026-10-26T22:16Z on ci-runner-07. The attached JUnit reports are timestamped 2026-10-23T13:30, before the commit existed, on host dev-laptop-7.local. They are not evidence of the suite passing on the final commit, and no test exercises reopen despite the description saying tests were updated.
The only touched component is mortgage.cases, which is not security_sensitive, so no security review is required.
No protected paths (controls/, control tests or ci/) are changed, so no control_owner approval is required.
No ledger entry covers CaseService.java. The covered code (Approvals, Policy, Underwriting, payments.py, audit.py, routes.py) is unchanged by this change.

summary: The change adds CaseService.reopen, a state-changing operation that writes no audit event, which violates AUD-1. No exception in the register covers this. The CI evidence is also invalid: the JUnit reports predate the commit and come from a developer workstation, not the CI runner named in run.json, so CHG-4 is not met. Ticket, independent approval and approval-on-head requirements are satisfied, but the violations require rejection.
